42.docs: Calls `U::from(self)`. That is, this conversion is whatever the implementation of [From]<T> for U chooses to do.

268.name: ravenrs_reactive
268.docs:
Reactive state for RavenRS.

The model is deliberately single-threaded (`Rc`/`Cell`, no locks): UI state
lives on the UI thread on every platform, including the browser main thread.

* [`State<T>`] owns a value. Reading it inside [`Observer::track`] records a
  dependency; writing it invalidates only the observers that read it.
* [`Binding<T>`] is a read/write view of some state that a child component can
  receive without knowing where the value lives (SwiftUI's `@Binding`).
* [`Derived<T>`] is a cached computation over other states (a memo).
* [`Observer`] is what the UI runtime uses to know when to rebuild.

Dependencies are re-collected on every tracked run. Instead of keeping back
references from observers to sources, each subscription carries the observer's
run *epoch*; a subscription from an older run is ignored and pruned on the next
notification. This keeps ownership one-directional (sources hold `Weak`
observers) and makes dropping either side safe at any time.

13.name: map
13.docs: Projects a binding onto a part of the value, e.g. one field of a struct.

163.name: invalidate
163.docs: Marks the observer dirty and fires its callback, as if a dependency changed.

238.name: binding
238.docs: A read/write view of this state for child components.

11.name: update
11.docs: Reads the value, lets `f` modify it, and writes it back.

162.name: is_dirty
162.docs: True until the first `track` and after any dependency changed.

86.name: Subscribers
86.docs: The set of observers that read a reactive value during their latest run.

237.name: update
237.docs: Mutates the value in place and notifies dependents.

161.name: untracked
161.docs: Runs `f` without recording dependencies for any observer.

186.name: notify
186.docs:
Invalidates every live, current subscriber and clears the list. Observers
re-subscribe the next time they run.

9.name: get
9.docs: Reads the current value through the getter.

160.name: track
160.docs: Runs `f`, replacing the previous dependency set with what `f` reads.

185.name: track_read
185.docs: Subscribes the innermost tracking observer, if any.

84.name: Observer
84.docs:
Runs a closure while recording which reactive values it reads, and calls
`on_invalidate` (once per run) when any of them changes.

235.name: set_if_changed
235.docs: Replaces the value only if it differs, notifying only on change.

159.name: new

234.name: set
234.docs: Replaces the value and notifies dependents.

7.name: constant
7.docs: A binding that always reads `value` and ignores writes; useful in previews and tests.

107.name: get
107.docs: Returns the cached value, recomputing it first if a dependency changed, and records the read.

6.name: new
6.docs: Creates a binding from a getter and a setter.

232.name: peek
232.docs: Borrows the value without recording a dependency.

5.name: Binding
5.docs:
A read/write handle to a value owned elsewhere (SwiftUI's `@Binding`).

Components that edit a value (a toggle, a text field) take a `Binding` so the
caller decides where the value lives. Reads are tracked like the underlying
state's reads.

231.name: with
231.docs: Reads the value by reference and records the read.

105.name: Derived
105.docs:
A cached value computed from other reactive values. It recomputes lazily, on
the first read after a dependency changed, and notifies its own readers when
that happens.

230.name: get
230.docs: Returns a clone of the value and records the read.

228.name: State
228.docs:
A mutable value that notifies the observers that read it. Cloning a `State`
clones the handle, not the value: all clones share one value.
